title: Best Black and Decker Dehumidifier (2026): 22, 36 & 50-Pint
dek: The power-tool brand sells straightforward 20- to 50-pint dehumidifiers with a clean recall record — and some of the widest price swings we've seen on one model.
description: The best Black and Decker dehumidifier for each space, from the 22-pint BD22MWSA to the 50-pint BDM50WCDA with pump, plus button, manual and recall answers.
intro: A **Black and Decker dehumidifier** might not be the first thing you think of from a brand known for drills and leaf blowers, but Black+Decker's Amazon lineup covers the essentials: a 22-pint, a 36.39-pint and two 50-pint models. For most basements, our pick is the **BLACK+DECKER 50-Pint Dehumidifier with Pump** (BDM50WCDA family), which drains itself instead of filling a bucket.

A note on model numbers: store stock and older units often carry BDT-series numbers (BDT20WTB, BDT30WTB, BDT50WTB, BDT50PWTB). Every card in this guide links the current Amazon listing named on it — the 22-pint BD22MWSA, the 36.39-pint BDM36WCDA and the 50-pint BDM50WCDA with and without a pump — so match the model number on the listing to the one on the card before you buy.

Two things are worth knowing before you shop. First, Black+Decker doesn't appear on either of the two largest dehumidifier recalls in U.S. history, which together covered dozens of other brand names. Second, pricing on the same model can vary wildly between retailers — the same Black+Decker model can list for nearly twice as much at one store as at another — so comparison shopping pays off here more than usual.
topPicksLead: The **BLACK+DECKER 50-Pint Dehumidifier with Pump** (BDM50WCDA family) is the best choice for most basements because its built-in pump lets it run for weeks without a bucket to empty.

products.whyWeLoveIt: In a basement where the nearest drain sits higher than the unit, a pump is what turns a dehumidifier from a chore into an appliance you can forget about. This is the Black+Decker 50-pint to pick if you can't run a gravity hose downhill.
products.performance: Amazon lists this BDM50WCDA pump model at 50 pints per 24 hours with coverage up to 4,500 square feet, Black+Decker's largest rating, and a 12.68-pint bucket. The pump pushes water out through a hose to a sink, window or standpipe, so the bucket becomes a backup rather than a daily chore. Confirm the humidity range, efficiency certification and hose length on the listing itself, since those details vary between Black+Decker generations. For more pump-equipped choices across brands, see our [dehumidifier with pump](/best/best-dehumidifier-with-pump/) guide.

blocks.text: We don't run a lab. We compare each model's capacity, coverage, bucket size and humidistat range from Black+Decker's spec sheets, confirm ENERGY STAR status, search CPSC recall records, and read owner reviews for recurring issues like pump failures, noisy fans or inaccurate humidity readings.
We also track pricing patterns across retailers — not to quote prices, which change daily, but because a model that swings wildly in price changes which pick represents real value.

sections.heading: What to look for in a Black+Decker dehumidifier

items.label: Coverage, not just pints
items.text: The 50-pint pump model is listed for up to 4,500 square feet. Beyond that, you need a second unit or a [whole-house system](/best/best-whole-house-dehumidifier/).

items.label: Pump or no pump
items.text: The pump model costs more but lets you skip emptying the bucket (12.68 pints on the pump listing). Worth it if the nearest drain is higher than the unit.

items.label: Price across retailers
items.text: Check at least three sellers. The same Black+Decker model can vary by close to double.

items.label: Model number on the listing
items.text: Black+Decker numbers vary by retailer and generation (BDT-series in some stores, BDM50WCDA on Amazon's 50-pint listings). Confirm the exact model and its ENERGY STAR status on the page you buy from.

items.label: Rival budget brands
items.text: Compare against Frigidaire, hOmeLabs and Midea in our [best budget dehumidifier](/best/best-budget-dehumidifier/) guide before you buy.

sections.heading: The recall lists Black+Decker isn't on

blocks.text: Two manufacturer recalls account for most dehumidifier fire-hazard headlines of the past decade. Black+Decker's name doesn't appear on either:

blocks.text: That's not a promise a Black+Decker unit will never be recalled — just the current public record. If you're buying secondhand, look up the exact model number on CPSC.gov regardless of brand.

sections.heading: Black and Decker dehumidifier manual and buttons

blocks.text: The model number is on the label on the back of the unit: older and store units use BDT-series numbers such as BDT20WTB, BDT30WTB, BDT50WTB or BDT50PWTB, while the current Amazon models are the BD22MWSA, BDM36WCDA and BDM50WCDA. Search that number on Black+Decker's appliance support pages or the retailer's listing to download the owner's manual.
Exact labels vary by model, so check your manual, but a typical Black+Decker panel includes:

items: **Power:** turns the unit on and off.
**Up/down arrows:** set your target humidity, usually in 5% steps; the display shows the room reading the rest of the time.
**Fan speed:** toggles between high and low.
**Timer:** sets an automatic on or off time.
**Mode or continuous:** on some models, runs the unit nonstop regardless of the humidistat — useful only for drying out a wet space.
**Filter light:** reminds you to rinse the washable filter; hold the indicated button to reset it afterward.

blocks.title: Good starting setting
blocks.text: Set the humidistat to 45–50% and the fan to auto or high. Our [humidistat settings guide](/guides/dehumidifier-humidistat-settings-guide/) has seasonal targets.

sections.heading: Are Black and Decker dehumidifiers good?

blocks.text: They're solid, conventional compressor units with a clean recall record. What they don't offer is anything you can't get elsewhere: no Wi-Fi, no collapsible design, no extended warranty. That makes the buying decision mostly about price on the day you shop.

blocks.text: If you find a Black+Decker at a genuinely good price, it's a sensible buy. If it's priced at the top of its range, a better-equipped rival may cost the same. Our [energy-efficient dehumidifier](/best/best-energy-efficient-dehumidifier/) guide lists the Most Efficient options.

For most basements, the **BLACK+DECKER 50-Pint Dehumidifier with Pump** (BDM50WCDA) is the one to buy: 4,500-square-foot coverage on its listing and a pump that drains it for you. The **22-Pint BD22MWSA** is the right size for a bedroom or apartment, the **36.39-Pint BDM36WCDA** fits mid-size rooms and is ENERGY STAR 6.0 certified per its listing, and the non-pump **50-Pint BDM50WCDA** saves money if a floor drain is nearby. Whichever you choose, shop several retailers — the price differences are real.

faqs.q: What is the best Black and Decker dehumidifier?
faqs.a: For basements, the BLACK+DECKER 50-Pint Dehumidifier with Pump (BDM50WCDA), which is listed for up to 4,500 square feet and drains itself. For a bedroom or small apartment, the 22-pint BD22MWSA, listed for up to 1,500 square feet.

faqs.q: Is the Black and Decker 4,500 sq ft dehumidifier worth it?
faqs.a: The 4,500-square-foot rating belongs to the 50-pint BDM50WCDA with pump. The pump is worth the extra cost if your drain is higher than the unit; otherwise the non-pump 50-pint BDM50WCDA with a gravity hose is the cheaper route. Older store units with the same ratings carry BDT50PWTB and BDT50WTB numbers.

faqs.q: Where can I find a Black and Decker dehumidifier manual?
faqs.a: Find the model number on the label on the back of the unit, then search it on Black+Decker's appliance support pages or the retailer's product listing to download the PDF manual.

faqs.q: What do the buttons on a Black and Decker dehumidifier do?
faqs.a: Typically: power, up/down arrows to set target humidity, fan speed, timer, and on some models a continuous mode. A filter light reminds you to rinse the filter. Check your model's manual for the exact labels.

faqs.q: Are Black and Decker dehumidifiers any good?
faqs.a: Yes, as straightforward compressor units with a clean recall history. They lack smart features and extended warranties, so they're best bought when the price is competitive with Midea, Frigidaire and hOmeLabs.

faqs.q: Has Black and Decker had a dehumidifier recall?
faqs.a: Black+Decker doesn't appear on the large Gree (2013) or New Widetech (2021) recalls, which covered dozens of other brand names. Still, check any secondhand unit's model number on CPSC.gov.

faqs.q: Who makes Black and Decker dehumidifiers?
faqs.a: Black+Decker licenses its name for home appliances, so the dehumidifiers are made by a licensed partner rather than the tool division. Check the manual or ENERGY STAR listing for your model's manufacturer details.
